description: Initial AssureAI pilot input pack: 5 synthetic RACM controls for a fictitious client (Solstice Financial Services), designed to exercise well-documented, incomplete, design-alignment, operating-gap, and insufficient-evidence behaviours. No real client data is used anywhere in this pack.

cases.expected_behavior: AssureAI should extract all six control attributes ALIGNED with the reference, cite a SUPPORTED source for each, and reach a PASS design conclusion consistent with the reviewer's - this is the baseline case confirming the system behaves well when the evidence is genuinely clean, not just that it can hedge on hard cases.

AssureAI should leave documentation.when and documentation.why as None and produce a MissingInformation entry for each (TRUE_POSITIVE expected), while still populating what/who/where/how from what the transcript does support. Pairs with well_documented (same User Access Management subprocess family) to exercise the consistency dimension: comparable controls, but a genuinely different completeness outcome justified by different evidence, not a contradiction.

Despite full documentation coverage, AssureAI should flag risk_objective_control_alignment as FAIL (self-review: the same person grants and reviews privileged access) rather than defaulting to PASS because all six attributes have text. The alignment conclusion should cite the specific exchange (L06-L08) that establishes the lack of independence - testing that AssureAI can produce a SUPPORTED citation for a critical/negative finding, not only for favourable ones.

AssureAI should reach a PASS design conclusion (the DESIGN is sound) while not raising any missing-information flags (all six attributes are answered) - a negative control proving the system distinguishes 'well documented' from 'operating effectively'. The operating-effectiveness evidence (L11-L14: 4 of 6 emergency changes missing approval, no escalation) is ground truth reserved for the not-yet-built gap-assessment agent (see expected_gap_indicator in the reference file) and should not be conflated with a design or documentation problem now.

AssureAI must NOT manufacture a design conclusion or plausible-sounding attribute values from an unreliable interviewee's hedged, contradictory answers. Expected: all six attributes left None, six MissingInformation entries, and design_assessment.* left at NOT_ASSESSED/UNKNOWN. Any PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL conclusion or populated attribute here is itself a material discrepancy (conclusion_despite_insufficient_evidence). Pairs with potential_gap (same Change Management subprocess family) for the consistency dimension.
